resources.string: Your upcoming events on your home screen.
Changes apply to the entire series, including past events.
Missing calendar dates are skipped (e.g. 31 February).
Allow Android notifications. Without exact alarm permission, Android may delay reminders.
Repeating events keep their time in this time zone. Times missing during daylight saving changes move forward.
Your changes have not been saved yet.
Editing and deleting apply to the entire series in this alpha.
Two resizable widgets. Colours and light/dark mode follow your app settings.
Widgets show all four calendars and enabled holidays. Touch and hold your home screen to change size and position.
If your device uses aggressive battery optimisation, check Android settings for Gimbo. Reminders are rescheduled after restarts and clock changes.
Your events stay on your device. A Gimbo backup also preserves recurring events, time zones and reminders.

ICS contains individual events and occurrences for the next 12 months. Use a Gimbo backup for complete series. Choose your own location; installed cloud providers are available in the Android file picker.
Reminders stay silent without notification permission. You can enable it later in settings.
Please allow exact alarms in Android app settings.
Touch and hold your home screen → Widgets → Gimbo Calendar.
Events could not be loaded. Please reopen the app.
This event has already been deleted.
The export is too large (10 MB maximum).
Calendar exported for the next 12 months
The backup is too large (10 MB maximum).
The action could not be completed.
Enter a title of no more than 200 characters.
End must follow start; 366 days maximum.
The date range is invalid due to a daylight saving change.
The series end is before the start.
No events in the next 3 months
The app supports German and English. Other system languages use English.
Holidays load only when you fetch them. Nager.Date receives country, year and your IP address, never your events. Downloaded data remain available offline.
Local holidays and special rules may be missing. Select a region after the first fetch.
All-day ICS entries without recurrence rules. Import replaces only the holiday file, never personal events. Works for any country.
This public holiday is read-only. Change country and region or hide holidays in settings.
Could not download holidays. Previously downloaded data are preserved.
The holiday file is too large (2 MB maximum).
Unsupported holiday file. Only all-day ICS entries without recurrence rules are allowed.
All past and future occurrences will also be deleted.
Month %1$s, today %2$s. Tap to open the calendar.
Existing events are preserved, including recurring events and reminders. Importing the same backup again creates duplicates.
This calendar name is already in use.
This calendar has already been removed.
Calendar deleted. Events have been moved.
Widgets show all personal calendars and enabled holidays. Change their size and position on your home screen.
The Gimbo backup includes personal calendar names and colours, events, recurring events, time zones and reminders.
Events and calendars will be added. Existing calendars with the same name and colour are reused. Name conflicts get an import suffix. Importing again creates duplicate events.
Choose your own names and colours. New events use the default calendar; an active filter takes priority.
Manage holidays separately in holiday settings. They stay read-only.
“%1$s” will be deleted. All events and series will move to your chosen calendar. Reminders are preserved.
The series has changed. Please open the event again.
Changing the start, time zone or recurrence changes the series pattern. Existing individual changes and skipped occurrences will be reset.
Only this occurrence will change. The rest of the series is preserved.
Changes apply to the series. Existing individual changes keep their own values.
Individual change to a recurring event
Only this occurrence will be skipped. The rest of the series is preserved.
The individual change will be removed. This occurrence will follow the original series again.
Even fully skipped or past recurring events remain available here.
No individual changes. All occurrences follow the series.
From the selected original occurrence. Earlier occurrences are preserved.
Earlier occurrences and their individual changes are preserved. Individual changes from the selected original series date are reset.
Earlier occurrences are preserved. Existing individual changes keep their values. The scope follows the original series date.

ICS includes complete series, individual changes and IANA time zones. Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly series are supported. Other rules are explained on import. Reimport adds duplicate events. You choose the storage location.
This ICS feature is not supported yet.
ICS contains duplicate or missing series masters.
Timed ICS events need an end time.
This ICS recurrence rule is not supported yet.
This ICS reminder is not supported yet.
This ICS time zone is not supported yet.
These settings apply to this widget only.
The available widget height also limits the number of events.
The widget could not be saved.
Device calendars could not be read.
Device import needs calendar permission. Local events remain available.
No device calendars found. You can add accounts in Android settings.
Imports individual occurrences for the next 12 months as a local copy. Later changes are not synchronized. Reminders stay with the original calendar; the copy initially has no reminder.
Completed. The next occurrence is scheduled.
Tasks have no notifications. Completing a recurring task advances its due date; missing calendar dates are skipped.
Events, tasks and calendars will be added. Matching calendars are reused; name conflicts get an import suffix. Reimport creates duplicate entries.
Timeline · touch and hold, then drag to move in 15-minute steps. The event editor opens before saving.
No templates yet. Save a template from an event’s details.
A birthday has an unsupported date format.
Birthdays are imported as local yearly events after contacts permission is granted. Reimport creates duplicates; contacts are unchanged. Leap-day birthdays appear only in leap years.
Only all-day holiday events are allowed.

All-day ICS series are imported for five years from this year. Single events keep their dates. Unsupported rules are rejected. Provider holidays use German names where available, otherwise the English name.
Import replaces only the holiday file, preserving personal events. Can be used for any country.
Use “Configure widget” to choose calendars, holidays, background opacity and the event limit for each widget. Resize and reposition it on the home screen.
Gimbo backup includes calendar names and colors, events with series and individual changes, tasks and templates. ICS exports events; tasks and templates are included in Gimbo Kalender backup.
Up to 10,000 occurrences are shown. Filter calendars or narrow the date range.
“%1$s” will be removed. Events, series, tasks and templates will move to the selected calendar. Reminders are preserved.
Shows this calendar read-only. Changes refresh when you open Gimbo and when calendar changes are reported. The original calendar app handles reminders.
Disconnected. The original calendar is preserved.
View Google, Microsoft or CalDAV calendars through accounts set up on Android. Gimbo reads selected calendars; make changes in the original calendar app.
One year before and after the selected date. Widgets read the next three months. At most 10 connected sources and 10,000 occurrences in total per view.
Connecting creates no local copies. These sources are excluded from Gimbo backups. Without read permission their events are hidden; local events remain available.
“%1$s” will be hidden in Gimbo Kalender. The original calendar and its events are preserved.
Some device calendars are unavailable. Check connections.
This event comes from a connected device calendar and is read-only in Gimbo Kalender. The original calendar app handles reminders.
View existing Android calendars. Make changes in the original calendar app.
Attachments belong to the entire series.
Private copies. Originals are preserved. Use a ZIP backup for files and departure reminders.
Attachment unavailable or no suitable app found.
New tasks are added. Unmodified tasks are updated. Local changes are preserved unless you choose to replace them.
Use file version and replace local task
OpenHolidays provides regional school holidays. Data are downloaded only on request; coverage and school groups vary by country.
The provider reports no school holidays for this selection. The source does not cover every school.
Add images, PDFs and text files in local event details. In Gallery, choose Share → Gimbo Calendar to create an event from an image.
ZIP includes local calendars, events, series, tasks, templates, private attachments and departure reminders. Connections and provider caches are configured separately.
Exchange VTODO files with date-only due dates and simple recurrence rules. Reimport matches the same UIDs and protects local changes. Compatible CalDAV task apps can import these files.
File exchange does not provide automatic CalDAV task synchronization.
Open a route in event details and set your travel time, buffer and departure reminder. Weather is downloaded only on request for entered coordinates or a permitted current location.
You enter the travel time. Gimbo reminds you before the event minus travel time and buffer; Android may delay delivery.
Coordinates are sent to MET Norway only when you request weather. Using your location fills them in without starting a weather request.
Cached forecast is more than 24 hours old.
Source: MET Norway · CC BY 4.0. Forecasts cover a limited period; weather is not a guaranteed travel advisory.
Tasks can remind you on their due date at your chosen time. Completing a recurring task sets its next due date; missing days of a month are skipped. Android may delay delivery.
Without write permission, device calendars remain read-only.
“%1$s” will be removed from “%2$s”. The Android provider synchronizes the deletion.
Device calendar: %1$s. Saving changes the original. The calendar app handles reminders.
The shared file is saved only when you save the event.
With additional write permission, simple one-off events can be changed directly in the device calendar. Edit series and invitations in the original app.
These school holidays are read-only. Change country, region and school group in Extensions.
All features are free to use. No Gimbo account needed. Device calendars use existing Android accounts.
Please open a file using the document picker.
Only images, PDFs and text files are allowed.
Travel time and buffer: 1 to 1440 minutes combined.
Departure reminders require an event with a time.
Please edit series and invitations in the original calendar app.
The original event or calendar changed. Please reopen it; nothing was overwritten.
Tasks changed in the meantime. Please reopen the import.
Unsupported task ICS file. Only VTODO with date-only due dates and simple recurrence rules is supported.
Choose a date and valid time for a task reminder.
No weather forecast is available for this date yet.
Weather could not be downloaded. Cached data are preserved.
No location available. Please enter coordinates.
Without location permission, you can enter coordinates manually.
Data could not be downloaded. Cached data are preserved.
Your search location is sent to OpenStreetMap Nominatim when you search. Weather is requested separately after you select a location.
No location found. Refine your search or enter coordinates.
Please enter a location with 2 to 200 characters.
Location search is currently unavailable. Use coordinates or your device location.
Private copies. Originals are kept. Use the ZIP backup to include attachments.
Your events, tasks and attachment copies stay privately on your device. No Gimbo account or server. Uninstalling removes local data; files you deliberately export remain.
JSON, ZIP and ICS are unencrypted. Only ZIP includes attachment files. Choose the destination carefully; Android app backup is disabled.
Calendar, contacts and approximate location require optional permissions. Your Android account provider syncs account calendars and edits. Attachments are copied only from selected files.

On explicit request: Nager receives country and year; OpenHolidays also receives region and school group; Nominatim receives your search place and language; MET Norway receives weather coordinates. Providers also see your IP address and technical request data. Your contacts, attachments and complete event texts are not sent automatically.
Remove weather and place-search caches in Connections & extensions. Maps, meeting links and sharing open external apps with the selected content; their privacy policies apply.
Data sources: OpenHolidays and OpenStreetMap · ODbL 1.0; MET Norway · CC BY 4.0. Gimbo summarises weather values.
Technical privacy information for this development build. Publisher details and the published privacy policy will be added before release.
No suitable app found to open this link.

The Gimbo backup includes local calendars, recurring events and exceptions, tasks with reminders, templates and departure reminders. To include attachment files, use ZIP backup in Connections & extensions.
This departure reminder applies to the whole series.
This event comes from a connected device calendar. The Android provider handles reminders and account sync.
View existing Android calendars. With additional permission, edit writable single events; manage series and invitations in the original app.
With a transparent background, choose text that contrasts with your wallpaper.
Resize the widget by holding and dragging it on your home screen. Its content adapts to the available width and height.
Use your home screen’s widget settings to enable hidden controls again.
No entries in the selected period
Multiple ICS categories are not yet supported.
Up to five reminders per event.
Create a calendar with Google, Microsoft or your CalDAV provider and invite people there. Then set up the account on Android and connect the shared calendar here.
No calendar in this group yet. Connect a calendar and assign it to a group.

Changes appear as soon as Android receives them from your provider. While the app is open, calendar changes are observed and regularly refreshed. Your connection and provider determine how quickly other people see changes.
Optionally request provider sync and update widgets every 15 minutes. Android may delay the timing. Local calendars are not shared by this; groups are personal labels.
Calendar sync is not set up for this account. Check Android account settings.
Categories organise events independently of calendars. Colours distinguish work, leisure or health at a glance.
“%1$s” will be removed from events and templates. Events will be kept.
Month, week, day or agenda – individually for each widget.
Choose view, calendars, transparency, colours, text size, spacing and tasks per widget. Resize and position it on your home screen.
Create your own categories in Settings → Categories.
Up to five reminders, up to four weeks before.
The connection to “%1$s” will be removed. The calendar and its events stay with the provider.
Make the widget taller to show the month.
This note has already been removed.
German and English are fully translated. Other languages have translated main navigation and controls; remaining text appears in English.
Add %1$s events, %2$s tasks, %3$s notes and %4$s templates?
Events, tasks, notes and calendars will be added. Matching calendars are reused; name conflicts receive an import suffix. Reimporting creates duplicates.

The Gimbo backup contains local calendars, categories, events with series and exceptions, notes and checklists, tasks with reminders, templates and departure reminders. For attachment files use ZIP backup under Connections & extensions.
